sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Mobileye Global Inc.

facts: Mobileye disclosed that on September 3, 2026, Executive Vice President Business Development & Strategy Nimrod Nehushtan transitioned to a part-time role focused on corporate strategy.
Following the transition, Vice President of Business Development Nimrod Brickman continues to lead Mobileye's business development activities.
The filing states Nehushtan's existing compensation arrangements had not been modified as of the September 10 filing date.

factors.name: governancePower
factors.basis: A senior strategy/business-development leadership transition creates a current governance/execution monitoring point, while the filing identifies an internal business-development successor rather than an unfilled function.

factors.name: catalystScore
factors.basis: Business-development leadership continuity matters to conversion of Mobileye's advanced ADAS, robotaxi and Physical AI pipeline, but the filing provides no evidence that commercial programs were delayed or cancelled.

factors.name: executionMonitoring
factors.basis: The transition is material enough for Item 5.02 disclosure and should be monitored against subsequent commercial wins, partnership execution and strategic milestones.

risks: Leadership transition in business development and strategy could create execution or relationship-continuity risk during a period of expansion into advanced ADAS, robotaxi and humanoid robotics.
The filing alone does not establish impairment; treating the transition as evidence of commercial deterioration would manufacture certainty.
unknowns: The filing does not state why Nehushtan moved to part-time status beyond the agreed transition.
No source-addressed evidence in this filing quantifies any effect on pipeline conversion, customer relationships, revenue guidance or strategic program timing.
The filing does not modify the previously disclosed CEO succession process and should not be conflated with it without separate lineage.
authorityBoundary: Source acquisition only. No numeric Earth Score, underwriting score, causal disposition, rank, tick or Chief decision is asserted.
